+"""Rolling-origin, group-aware backtest splits.
+
+The dataset is a sequence of row mappings (e.g. rows from csv.DictReader)
+with a time column and a group column. Time values are treated as discrete,
+ordered periods: splits operate on the sorted distinct time values ("the
+grid"), and all window sizes -- train_window, horizon, step, gap -- are
+measured in grid steps, not in rows or wall-clock time. Feed in a column
+already bucketed to the period size you care about (e.g. an integer day
+index or an ISO date string) so grid steps match calendar periods.
+
+Fold semantics, for an origin at grid position o:
+
+    train window : grid positions [o - train_window, o)   (sliding)
+                   grid positions [0, o)                  (expanding)
+    gap          : grid positions [o, o + gap) are dropped
+    test window  : grid positions [o + gap, o + gap + horizon)
+
+The first fold uses the smallest origin that satisfies the train window
+(train_window for sliding, min_train for expanding); each subsequent origin
+advances by `step` grid positions. Folds stop once the test window would run
+past the end of the grid.
+
+Group awareness: the same grid cutoffs are applied to every group, so within
+a fold every group's train rows strictly precede its test rows. A group is
+included in a fold only if it has at least one row in both the train and the
+test window; groups with too little data are omitted from that fold. A fold
+where no group qualifies is skipped.
+
+Fold rows are sorted by (time, group) and are the same dict objects as the
+input rows, not copies.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import defaultdict
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Mapping, Sequence
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Fold:
+    """One rolling-origin fold.
+
+    origin     : last time value used for training (the forecast origin)
+    test_start : first time value of the test window
+    test_end   : last time value of the test window
+    train/test : rows of the participating groups, sorted by (time, group)
+    """
+
+    index: int
+    origin: Any
+    test_start: Any
+    test_end: Any
+    train: tuple[Mapping, ...]
+    test: tuple[Mapping, ...]
+
+
+def rolling_origin_splits(
+    rows: Sequence[Mapping],
+    *,
+    time_col: str,
+    group_col: str,
+    horizon: int,
+    train_window: int | None = None,
+    step: int = 1,
+    gap: int = 0,
+    min_train: int = 1,
+) -> list[Fold]:
+    """Split `rows` into rolling-origin folds.
+
+    Args:
+        rows: row mappings, each containing `time_col` and `group_col`.
+        time_col: column of mutually sortable, discrete time values.
+        group_col: column identifying the group each row belongs to.
+        horizon: test window length in grid steps (>= 1).
+        train_window: training window length in grid steps; None for an
+            expanding window that uses all history before the origin.
+        step: origin advance per fold, in grid steps (>= 1).
+        gap: number of grid steps dropped between train end and test
+            start (>= 0).
+        min_train: smallest expanding-window training length in grid steps
+            (>= 1). Ignored when train_window is given.
+
+    Returns:
+        Folds in chronological order with contiguous 0-based `index`.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: on invalid configuration, empty input, or an input too
+            short to produce a single fold.
+    """
+    if horizon < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"horizon must be >= 1, got {horizon}")
+    if step < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"step must be >= 1, got {step}")
+    if gap < 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"gap must be >= 0, got {gap}")
+    if train_window is not None and train_window < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"train_window must be >= 1 or None, got {train_window}")
+    if min_train < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"min_train must be >= 1, got {min_train}")
+    if not rows:
+        raise ValueError("rows must not be empty")
+
+    grid = sorted({row[time_col] for row in rows})
+    n = len(grid)
+    pos_of = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(grid)}
+
+    rows_at: dict[int, list[Mapping]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for row in rows:
+        rows_at[pos_of[row[time_col]]].append(row)
+
+    first_origin = train_window if train_window is not None else min_train
+    if first_origin + gap + horizon > n:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"dataset too short: grid has {n} time steps but the first fold "
+            f"needs {first_origin} train + {gap} gap + {horizon} horizon"
+        )
+
+    folds: list[Fold] = []
+    origin_idx = first_origin
+    while origin_idx + gap + horizon <= n:
+        test_lo = origin_idx + gap
+        train_lo = origin_idx - train_window if train_window is not None else 0
+
+        train_by_group: dict[Any, list[Mapping]] = defaultdict(list)
+        for p in range(train_lo, origin_idx):
+            for row in rows_at.get(p, ()):
+                train_by_group[row[group_col]].append(row)
+        test_by_group: dict[Any, list[Mapping]] = defaultdict(list)
+        for p in range(test_lo, test_lo + horizon):
+            for row in rows_at.get(p, ()):
+                test_by_group[row[group_col]].append(row)
+
+        shared = sorted(set(train_by_group) & set(test_by_group))
+        if not shared:
+            origin_idx += step
+            continue
+
+        key = lambda r: (r[time_col], r[group_col])
+        train = sorted((r for g in shared for r in train_by_group[g]), key=key)
+        test = sorted((r for g in shared for r in test_by_group[g]), key=key)
+
+        folds.append(Fold(
+            index=len(folds),
+            origin=grid[origin_idx - 1],
+            test_start=grid[test_lo],
+            test_end=grid[test_lo + horizon - 1],
+            train=tuple(train),
+            test=tuple(test),
+        ))
+        origin_idx += step
+
+    return folds
